theme_strategy.name: dark_underground_broadcast
theme_strategy.description: Deep black and near-black purple surfaces, neon semantic hierarchy, cinematic film presentation, controlled glows, dense but highly composed bento-style information architecture.

rules: Headings & Section Labels: MUST be uppercase, heavily condensed display font, tightly tracked.
Body: Highly readable Sans-Serif. Never use 'Inter' for headings. Essential for movie plots and legal texts.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle CRT grain/scanlines on hero components and video player edges. Avoid heavy performance-draining filters.
visual_enhancers.glows: Semantic glows only. Do not random-glow. Example: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,102,0.3)] for online status.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin 1px luminous borders. No thick borders.

grid_layouts.desktop: 12-column grid layout with gap-6. Left sidebar (col-span-3), Center Main (col-span-6), Right sidebar (col-span-3).
grid_layouts.mobile: Mobile is a separate information architecture. Stack logically: Navbar -> Live Scoreboard -> Main Video/Hero -> Left Sidebar Content (Leagues) -> Right Sidebar Content (Channels) -> Footer.
grid_layouts.spacing: Dense but padded. Containers MUST have generous internal padding (p-4 or p-6) to prevent text collision.

navbar.structure: Logo 'banbansports UNDERGROUND HD' + CANLI badge -> Center Nav Links (MAÇ MERKEZİ, TV KANALLARI, FİLMLER, vb.) -> Notification toggle + FPS counter.
navbar.style: Sticky top, glassmorphism surface, NEVER fully transparent.

left_sidebar.structure: MAÇ MERKEZİ league filters (vertical list) -> YAKLAŞAN MAÇLAR (compact match list) -> Ad banner.
left_sidebar.style: Dark elevated surface cards. Active state gets Cyan neon border and text.

center_main.structure: Big hero scoreboard (TRENDYOL SÜPER LİG carousel) -> GÜNÜN MAÇI with countdown & İZLE CTA -> Large cinematic video player with quote & PRESS PLAY -> Ad banners -> BOX OFFICE cinematic card.
center_main.style: Cinematic presentation. Maximize negative space inside the bounding box. Box office card requires IMDb badge, currency tabs, and revenue stats in Monospace.
center_main.hero_overlay: Gradient overlay from bottom up to ensure text visibility.

right_sidebar.structure: CANLI YAYINDA channel logo grid -> TV KANALLARI list with CANLI status -> SUNUCULAR server list with latency (ms) -> ÖZET summary text.
right_sidebar.style: Dense data view. Use Green for AKTİF/CANLI, Red for DEVRE DIŞI. Numbers in Monospace.

bottom_sections.structure: League logo strip (all leagues) -> Scrolling announcement ticker -> SPONSORLARIMIZ (large featured + dense grid) -> Footer.
bottom_sections.style: Ticker must use react-fast-marquee, dark background, cyan text. Sponsor logos must have hover glows.

footer.structure: Social cards (@lenstedreal), TELEGRAM DESTEK, YASAL BİLGİLENDİRME buttons, FOOTBALL SUPPLIERS (Adidas/Nike/Puma), DMCA, 5G badge.
footer.style: High detail, technical broadcast styling. Footer links should be muted but readable.

rules: Micro-interactions only. No heavy constant animations.
Hover states: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5), glow expansion, and text color shift.
Neon pulse: Only for critical 'LIVE' or 'RECORDING' indicators.
Ensure min 4.5:1 contrast for body text. Dark background requires pure white or light gray text.
Interactive elements must have distinct focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500).
Always include data-testid on all interactive and key informational elements.

media.images: Reuse existing assets (/footy/leagues/*.svg, /logos/channels/*.png, movie posters, ads). Do not replace with placeholders.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a Next.js 15 App Router app using Tailwind CSS 3.4. Use JavaScript (.js, .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors and fonts defined in this JSON.
Do NOT use shadcn/ui. This project uses pure Tailwind utility classes and custom components.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons if needed, but prioritize existing SVGs.
Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the scrolling announcement ticker.
Preserve existing application logic, API calls, and data structures. REBUILD THE EXPERIENCE, DO NOT BREAK THE SYSTEM.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop' layouts. Follow the dense, dark, cyberpunk/underground cinematic theme strictly.
NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers.
Use distinct z-index layering for glassmorphism effects.
Create depth with shadows and subtle 1px luminous borders.
All interactive elements must include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.
